statement: There are n balloons in a row, and balloon i carries the number nums[i]. You burst them one at a time until none are left.
Bursting balloon i earns left × nums[i] × right coins, where left and right are the numbers on the balloons currently next to it. A side with no balloon counts as 1.
Return the most coins you can earn by choosing the order in which to burst the balloons.

examples.explanation: Bursting 1 first earns 1·1·5 = 5, then bursting 5 earns 1·5·1 = 5, for 10. The other order earns only 5 + 1 = 6.
